 EPF balance check on WhatsApp: 89.88 lakh members used EPFO service in 14 days; how to check yours?
 To access the service, members simply need to send a 'Hi' message to the designated EPFO WhatsApp number, +91 8796441800. 
 Dipen Pradhan 
 November 18, 2026 / 16:55 IST 
 Story continues below Advertisement 
 Remove Ad 
 EPFO now offers member services via WhatsApp.
 Over 8.9 million checked balances in 14 days.
 Send Hi to +91 8796441800 to use the service.

 Members of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) can now check their balance, download their passbook, and access other services through WhatsApp, making it easier to seek information without visiting an EPFO office or the official website.
 According to EPFO's post on social media X (November 18), as many as 89.88 lakh members checked their EPF balance through the WhatsApp service in just 14 days of its launch.
 Story continues below Advertisement 
 Remove Ad 
 Along with the balance check option, members can also check the last five transactions and download their passbook.
 To access the service, members simply need to send a 'Hi' message to the designated EPFO WhatsApp number, +91 8796441800.
 In a post on X, EPFO highlighted the usage of its WhatsApp service and encouraged members to use the facility to access its services.

 EPF balance check: Step-by-step process 
 Story continues below Advertisement 
 Remove Ad 
 Send Hi on WhatsApp to  +91 8796441800 
Choose a language (currently available in 10 languages) 
Select Options: Check Balance, Last 5 Transactions, Download Passbook (PDF, password-protected) 
Enter the OTP sent to your registered number 
Select a Member ID to continue (It will highlight Member IDs of your previous employment, too) 
The EPFO will show your total PF balance, employee and employer share, pension contribution, and the latest contribution. 
Members can also download passbook and change Member ID.
 Members should ensure they contact the official EPFO WhatsApp number and avoid sharing sensitive information such as passwords, OTPs, or banking credentials through unofficial channels.
 How to join EPFO WhatsApp Channel 
 Notably, EPFO also runs a separate official WhatsApp channel, created on August 19, 2025, according to the channel's information. Since then, EPFO has posted updates on several matters, including the Universal Account Number (UAN), the Amnesty Scheme 2026, the Employees Enrollment Campaign 2026, Jeevan Pramaan, among other developments.
 The WhatsApp channel provides another way for EPFO members to track official announcements without regularly visiting the organisation's website or social media accounts.
 Members can follow the EPFO WhatsApp channel by following these steps.
 Open WhatsApp and go to the Updates sections 
Under Channels, select Explore 
Search for "EPFO" 
Select the official EPFO channel and tap Follow 
As of the time of writing, the EPFO's WhatsApp channel had 2,99,388 followers.
